candidates.change_summary: Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender.
Call withdraw with zero value instead of the full contract balance.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is not the owner (inverting the access control).
Replace transfer to send with a boolean-checked call, which changes behavior if call fails (does not revert on failure vs original revert behavior).
Modify onlyOwner to allow anyone (removes the require), changing who can call withdraw and thus observable balances after withdraw calls.
Make withdraw use a smaller amount (subtract 1 wei) before transfer, changing final balances observed by caller.
Replace low-level call with a transfer, which will revert on failure and thus can change whether state is modified or revert occurs.
Replace low-level call with a call that forwards all gas and check return value, reverting on failure, changing post-call state exposure when the target reverts.
Change low-level call to a call that uses a very small fixed gas stipend (2300), which may cause differening behavior if the recipient requires more gas in its fallback/receive.
Make onlyOwner modifier allow anyone (remove the require), changing whether sendMoney is callable by non-owners and thus the observable state after calls.
